a0886.reason: Marseille was stated flatly to be France's oldest city; encyclopedias disagree (Store norske leksikon counts it second after Béziers), so the body now says it is 'often called' the oldest. Barcelona's population was updated from 1.6 to about 1.7 million (1.73 million in 2025).

a0994.reason: The body said Zimbabwe's 16 official languages were the world record; Bolivia's 2009 constitution makes Spanish and 36 indigenous languages official (37), so Zimbabwe is second. The sentence now says Zimbabwe comes close to the record and names Bolivia.

f12015.reason: Span moved to the reworded sentence that now states Zimbabwe's 16 official languages.

w12127.reason: 'Since its 2013 constitutional amendment' read as if an amendment added the languages; the 16 languages come from the 2013 constitution itself (formally enacted as Amendment No. 20), so the question now says 'since its 2013 constitution'.
